metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for iOS, Android, and React Native. Per-stack init / plan / review pipelines with high-signal review filtering. Every command is ov- prefixed.

plugins.name: ov-ios
plugins.description: Native iOS (Swift / SwiftUI / UIKit / Obj-C) — init, plan, review-deep.

plugins.name: ov-android
plugins.description: Native Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose / View system) — init, plan, review-deep.

plugins.name: ov-rn-typescript
plugins.description: React Native TypeScript/JavaScript layer — init, plan, review-deep.

plugins.name: ov-rn-ios-native
plugins.description: React Native iOS bridge (Swift / Obj-C / Obj-C++) — init, plan, review-deep.

plugins.name: ov-rn-android-native
plugins.description: React Native Android bridge (Kotlin / Java) — init, plan, review-deep.

plugins.name: ov-pr
plugins.description: Lightweight, platform-neutral GitHub PR review — review-quick. One pass, at most three findings, posted as per-line questions.
